_: What each role needs from a box (docs/dev/hardware.md has the evidence). requires: against the box's signed report (fleet/boxes/<box>/hardware.json); box: against its owner's box.json; with: roles that must be on the same box, because the code reaches them on localhost; perFleet: exactly that many boxes run it. nix/tests/role-fit.nix fails when fleet/boxes.json breaks any of it. services: what the role brings, by the names in the needs (.#needs, nix/lib/needs.nix); a service may come with several roles. nix/lib/capability.nix holds each box to the needs of every service its roles bring, and checks this list against what the box really runs (nix/tests/placement.nix).

core.why: every box: the disk unlock needs the TPM and a cable its initrd has the driver for

gateway.why: one public front door (dd-dns points *.domain at it); s3.<domain> proxies its own garage

storage.why: garage: a dataset for blocks; rf=2, so the smallest box caps the usable space

photos.why: photos.<domain> and the gate; its database is its own (the ledger reads counts, not databases)

vault.why: passwords; its sign-in issuer is the gate at home.<domain>, the gateway's, and sessions are per box; garage reached at the storage pool's address, not localhost

media.why: files.<domain>: Files, Movies & TV and the disk images, through the gate

library.why: transcode: H.264 encode on a GPU (Intel only today), else every core

llm.why: a 22G model held in RAM beside the rest; any GPU, any SIMD (nix/modules/llm/needs.nix)

game.why: every world is a KVM guest of 6-8G; the budget is 20G

forge.why: git.<domain>, and postgres shared with photos and vault

runner.why: VM tests (games nests one) and members' jobs; the nix cache at the storage pool's address (nix/modules/forge/needs.nix)

observe.why: thanos keeps to local garage; the dumps take ente's and forgejo's databases

adblock.why: it answers the house's DNS: the box has to be in the house, with who lives there

compute.why: members' computers are KVM guests, each its own size: a box takes those that fit (its vm.prom says how big), so a small box still runs small ones
